security_audit.summary: Most static findings are benign examples for local API mocking, request matching, configuration, and Markdown resource links. Two low-severity findings remain because the documentation sample loads Swagger UI assets from unpkg.com, which adds an external dependency if copied directly.

remediation.issue: Interactive documentation loads Swagger UI assets from unpkg.com.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle Swagger UI locally or pin exact asset versions with integrity checks and a documented allowlist.

content.value_statement: API teams need reliable mocks before every dependency is ready. This skill designs mock servers, scenarios, fixtures, and validation plans for safer testing.
actual_capabilities: Designs mock server routes, middleware, and response handling patterns.
Defines request matching, stub priority, state transitions, and scenario flows.
Generates mock data strategies from schemas and controlled randomness.
Plans contract-based mocks from OpenAPI or similar API specifications.
Outlines test framework integration for Jest and pytest workflows.
Creates deployment and documentation guidance for mock services.
limitations: Does not test live production systems or real third-party integrations.
Requires an API contract or clear expected behavior to produce accurate mocks.
Generated examples need project-specific validation before use.
Mock data should not include production secrets or real customer records.

use_cases.title: Unblock Frontend Development
use_cases.description: Create stable mock endpoints so UI teams can build against expected responses before backend work is finished.

use_cases.title: Validate API Contracts
use_cases.description: Turn OpenAPI requirements into mock behavior that checks request and response shapes during integration work.

use_cases.title: Prepare Reliable Demos
use_cases.description: Build predictable demo scenarios with happy paths, errors, latency, and seeded mock data.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Mock Routes
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a small API surface.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a basic mock API for my user profile endpoints. Ask clarifying questions before defining routes and responses.

prompt_templates.title: Add Test Scenarios
prompt_templates.prompt: Design mock scenarios for login, locked accounts, rate limits, and slow responses. Include state changes and request verification needs.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Contract Mocks
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my OpenAPI summary to plan contract-based mocks. Include validation rules, generated fixtures, and response examples in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Full Mock Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a team mock platform with scenarios, seeded data, observability, CI integration, deployment, and documentation. Note security boundaries.

output_examples.input: A frontend team needs user, orders, and billing mocks for local development.
output: A route plan grouped by service area and endpoint purpose.
Scenario names for success, validation errors, empty states, and degraded latency.
A fixture strategy with seeded data and reset behavior.

output_examples.input: A backend team wants mocks generated from an API contract.
output: A contract mapping from operations to mock responses.
Validation notes for required fields, status codes, and error shapes.
Testing guidance for request matching and response verification.

output_examples.input: A product team needs a stable demo environment for a partner review.
output: A demo scenario sequence with predictable state transitions.
Recommended mock data sets for realistic but synthetic records.
Operational notes for switching scenarios during the demo.

best_practices: Start from a clear API contract, expected auth behavior, and known error shapes.
Use deterministic fixtures by default, then add controlled randomness only when needed.
Label mock endpoints clearly and keep production secrets out of all mock data.
anti_patterns: Do not point mock clients at production systems during development tests.
Do not build mocks from vague endpoint names without request and response details.
Do not store real customer data in fixtures, request logs, or demo scenarios.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps design mock API services with routes, scenarios, generated data, validation, deployment notes, and documentation.

faq.question: Can it work from an OpenAPI contract?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan mocks from OpenAPI-style contracts when endpoint details, schemas, and response codes are available.

faq.question: Does it call live APIs?
faq.answer: No. The skill is intended for local or controlled mock services, not production API testing.

faq.question: Can it create error and latency scenarios?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define rate limits, locked accounts, slow responses, timeouts, and other scenario states.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide endpoint paths, methods, schemas, auth expectations, sample errors, latency needs, and test goals.

faq.question: Is generated mock code production ready?
faq.answer: No. Treat generated examples as implementation guidance that requires review, testing, and security validation.
